scores.evidence: Phase 3 "Depends on: Templates proven on varied services, and signing and provenance proven in audit mode."
scores.rationale: Each phase names its dependency and proof, and enforcement follows audit-mode proof, so ordering runs from substrate upward.

scores.evidence: Merge a one-line change to one real, low-risk, stateless service... commit running in prod and serving real traffic.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end commit-to-prod slice with a demonstrated rollback.

scores.evidence: Consistency for deploy state... Flip condition: Git-host outages block hotfixes more than once a quarter.
scores.rationale: The table lists irreversible decisions, each with a default and a concrete flip condition, and states its assumptions.

scores.evidence: Tasks (widest blast radius first)... A template change reaches all 50 services, so this mechanism comes first.
scores.rationale: Each phase orders its work by blast radius and justifies it. The one exception, onboarding waves, is called out and explained.

scores.evidence: OIDC to the registry from day one, with no static keys. Branch protection on `main` and `deploy-config`.
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security work in every phase from 0 to 5.

scores.evidence: Every pipeline stage emits an OpenTelemetry span, with commit SHA and digest as attributes.
scores.rationale: Observability is concrete in Phase 0 and in every later phase.

scores.evidence: Base image pinned by digest. Actions pinned by SHA. Lockfiles. Platform infra in Terraform. Build once, promote the digest.
scores.rationale: Reproducibility work appears in each phase, from pinning and Terraform through to deterministic test-impact analysis.

scores.evidence: Rollback by `git revert`, demonstrated. A documented manual break-glass deploy of the last known-good manifest.
scores.rationale: Resilience work starts in Phase 0 and continues through every phase, ending in DR and chaos drills.

scores.evidence: N/A. This is a pure infra system with no model, retrieval or agent components.
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Ephemeral preview environments per PR. Pull forward when review or QA cycle time becomes the top bottleneck
scores.rationale: Each deferred item has a specific pull-forward condition.

note: Very strong plan: a real walking skeleton, explicit gates with flip conditions, per-phase cross-cutting treatment, and deferred items with triggers.
